why.c1: Both sides are presented clearly, though the 'smuggling induction' argument relies on a standard uniformity principle rather than the more sophisticated Salmon-style critique.
why.c2: Fails to name specific Popperian texts (Objective Knowledge) or the precise definition of corroboration as a non-predictive report; uses generic terms like 'methodological rule of thumb'.
why.c3: Identifies a survivor in Conjecture 7 but dilutes the commitment by presenting eight separate 'conjectures' rather than a single synthesized verdict.
why.c4: Names a real cost (loss of assurance/probability), but it is somewhat generic and repeated across multiple conjectures rather than deeply analyzed as a specific philosophical concession.
why.c5: Partially evades by scattering the answer across eight distinct points, effectively dissolving the tension into a list of options rather than holding and resolving the contradiction in a unified argument.
